helpdesk-note.body: Hi Fairuz Syamimi Ehsanuddin, ​For analyzer mapping we have several methods to do it. 1. Analyzer Test code to LIS Test Code 2. Analyzer Reagent code to LIS Test Code 3. Analyzer Reagent no to LIS Test Code You can refer to Analyzer Master Setup and gather the info from the function. As per your query : User give the analyzer test code as below However, when compare to the Master - Analyzer setup, we use Reagent No to map. Please confirm with the user, is the Reagent code for the HBSAGC differ from the current setup? If YES, you can delete the record and add in the new reagent no and map to HBSAGC test code. If No, you can remain the current setup. Regards, Norshafina AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Fairuz Syamimi Ehsanuddin,

​For analyzer mapping we have several methods to do it. 
1. Analyzer Test code to LIS Test Code
2. Analyzer Reagent code to LIS Test Code
3. Analyzer Reagent no to LIS Test Code


You can refer to Analyzer Master Setup and gather the info from the function.
As per your query :

User give the analyzer test code as below
 

However, when compare to the Master - Analyzer setup, we use Reagent No to map.

Please confirm with the user, is the Reagent code for the HBSAGC differ from the current setup?
If YES, you can delete the record and add in the new reagent no and map to HBSAGC test code.
If No, you can remain the current setup.

Regards,
Norshafina AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hi AdeaHub support team, User reports issue at Maxcare Production where Transaction / Balance is not seen at Maxcare Dispensing module. Script number SGH-26-12861433, order for 0004-10-083-H Nilotinib 150mg Cap [TASIGNA], total qty 360 CAP Ÿ User dispenses 120 CAP into visit 6824242315G0050 by performing the following steps: § Open the visit at Maxcare Dispensing § Select e-Rx order from Prescription tab and click Dispense >> Full dispense balance of 3 months, 360 CAP § Then, at Dispensing tab, open F9 window and change duration to 1 month (120 CAP), then F12 to save Balance of 240 CAP returns to Prescription tab Ÿ Then user dispenses 120 CAP into visit 6824242315G0051 by performing the same steps as above § Open the visit at Maxcare Dispensing § Select e-Rx order from Prescription tab and click Dispense >> Full dispense balance of 2 months, 240 CAP § Then, at Dispensing tab, open F9 window and change duration to 1 month (120 CAP), then F12 to save Balance of 120 CAP did not return to Prescription tab Ÿ User is unable to dispense the balance into new visit. Checked Item History, noted there was record of Sales = 120 CAP at 13/02/2026 15:51 (same timestamp as return of 120 CAP), into blank visit number with no patient or visit information: Kindly assist to raise for investigation and fix. Thanks.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: (SGH Maxcare Production) Transaction / Balance not seen at Maxcare Dispensing module
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi AdeaHub support team,
 
User reports issue at Maxcare Production where Transaction / Balance is not seen at Maxcare Dispensing module.
 
Script number SGH-26-12861433, order for 0004-10-083-H Nilotinib 150mg Cap [TASIGNA], total qty 360 CAP
Ÿ User dispenses 120 CAP into visit 6824242315G0050 by performing the following steps:
§ Open the visit at Maxcare Dispensing
§ Select e-Rx order from Prescription tab and click Dispense >> Full dispense balance of 3 months, 360 CAP
§ Then, at Dispensing tab, open F9 window and change duration to 1 month (120 CAP), then F12 to save
Balance of 240 CAP returns to Prescription tab
Ÿ Then user dispenses 120 CAP into visit 6824242315G0051 by performing the same steps as above
§ Open the visit at Maxcare Dispensing
§ Select e-Rx order from Prescription tab and click Dispense >> Full dispense balance of 2 months, 240 CAP
§ Then, at Dispensing tab, open F9 window and change duration to 1 month (120 CAP), then F12 to save
Balance of 120 CAP did not return to Prescription tab
Ÿ User is unable to dispense the balance into new visit.
 
Checked Item History, noted there was record of Sales = 120 CAP at 13/02/2026 15:51 (same timestamp as return of 120 CAP), into blank visit number with no patient or visit information:
 
Kindly assist to raise for investigation and fix.
 
Thanks.

From: Elbin Eldhose <elbin.eldhose@dedalus.com<mailto:elbin.eldhose@dedalus.com>> Sent: Monday, September 1, 2025 5:34 PM To: Saravanan Ramamurthy <sramamurthy7@dedalus.com<mailto:sramamurthy7@dedalus.com>> Cc: Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com<mailto:nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com>>; Jade Lau <jlau32@dedalus.com<mailto:jlau32@dedalus.com>>; Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com<mailto:dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com>> Subject: CUST1232772 - SGH PROD- No message send to SCM, Fastrak and OAS after user performs reset encounter
Hi Saravanan,
We have received an issue where SGH user inappropriately performs reset encounter when another SGH user is accessing the visit at Dispensing Module.
Here are the timeline and actions performed by both users (USER 1 GPAKHI and USER 2 GPAWTZ )
Step 1: User GPAKHI starts encounter from 26.08.2025 12:53:56 to 26.08.2025 12:55:06 Step 2: User GPAKHI dispense 190 tab at 26.08.2025 12:54:13 Step 3: User GPAWTZ starts another encounter (reset encounter) from 26.08.2025 12:54:20 to 26.08.2025 12:56:59 Step 4: User GPAKHI Change qty 90 tab to create SR 100 tab at 26.08.2025 12:54:22 Step 5: User GPAKHI F7 and DFTP03 created at 26.08.2025 12:55:06 and sent to OAS. Step 6: Screen of the User GPAWTZ is 190 Tab. User GPAWTZ deleted 190 tab to created Double SR of 100 tab and SR of 90 tab at 26.08.2025 12:55:17 Step 7: Maxcare.A_billing_transaction table shows AUDIT_TRANSACTION_DATE 26.08.2025 12:55:16 , AUDIT_TRANSACTION_USER GPAWTZ , 90 Tab ( this one is the trigger job to insert based on the real time in BLTX when delete happened. Hence, 90 is captured) Step 8: Upon F7 by GPAWTZ no CD message was sent to (OAS). The info loaded at Step 6, the TRDS_BL_IE_MSG was N. So, did not create data in the PSMM hence no trigger at F7 .
In order to fix this issue from happening again, Is it possible to prompt USER 2 when doing step 6 that data has been amended by USER 1 and refresh the data.
Regards
Elbin Eldhose
________________________________
From: Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg<mailto:er.wei.may@synapxe.sg>> Sent: Wednesday, August 27, 2025 5:54 PM To: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com<mailto:dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com>> Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg<mailto:rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg<mailto:prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg<mailto:idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg>> Subject: (SGH Maxcare Production) - No message send to SCM, Fastrak and OAS after user performs reset encounter
CAUTION - This e-mail originates outside of Dedalus. Be vigilant with content, links and attachments!
Hi Dedalus support team,
SGH user reported a case where user inappropriately performs reset encounter when another user is accessing visit at Dispensing Module.
Noticed the following unexpected behaviours highlighted in yellow. Seeking clarification on whether any of these behaviours would be incorrect and should be fixed.
* E-Rx SGH-25-12499521 for 0004-88-053-G, Ordered Qty calculated as 189 TAB, to round up to 190 TAB (sales multiple 10) at the dispensing pharmacy
* User 1 partial dispensed 90 TAB Item History: Qty Out 190 then Qty In 100
* Not known if the following actions had occurred concurrently
* User 2 reset encounter
* User 1 F7 >> Send interface messages to SCM (medication dispensed), Fastrak (pick 90 tab), and OAS (bill 90 tab)
* User 2, open visit, and delete the dispensed transaction of 90 TAB Item History: Qty In 100 then Qty In 90
* When User 2 F7, no interface message generated to send to SCM (to clear Medication Dispensed status), Fastrak (cancel picking) or OAS (cancel bill 90 tab)
* No stuck transaction seen at SendCancelDeleteMsg utility program (presumably, means not found at PSMM table). No messages is not created to send to SCM, fastrak and OAS for the transaction performed by User 2.
[cid:image005.png@01DCA655.330419D0]
For your investigation and clarification for this scenario. Thank you.
Regds,

Subject: CUST1232772 - SGH PROD- No message send to SCM, Fastrak and OAS after user performs reset encounter
 
Hi Saravanan, 
 
We have received an issue where SGH user inappropriately performs reset encounter when another SGH user is accessing the visit at Dispensing Module. 
Here are the timeline and actions performed by both users (USER 1 GPAKHI and USER 2 GPAWTZ )
 
Step 1: User GPAKHI starts encounter from  26.08.2025 12:53:56 to 26.08.2025 12:55:06
Step 2: User GPAKHI dispense 190 tab  at 26.08.2025 12:54:13
Step 3: User GPAWTZ starts another encounter (reset encounter)  from 26.08.2025 12:54:20 to  26.08.2025 12:56:59
Step 4: User GPAKHI Change qty 90 tab to create SR 100 tab at 26.08.2025 12:54:22
Step 5: User GPAKHI F7 and DFTP03 created at 26.08.2025 12:55:06 and sent to OAS. 
Step 6:  Screen of the User GPAWTZ is 190 Tab.  User GPAWTZ deleted  190 tab  to created Double SR of 100 tab and SR of 90 tab at  26.08.2025 12:55:17
Step 7: Maxcare.A_billing_transaction table shows  AUDIT_TRANSACTION_DATE 26.08.2025 12:55:16 , AUDIT_TRANSACTION_USER GPAWTZ , 90 Tab   ( this one is the trigger job to insert based on the real time in BLTX when delete happened.  Hence, 90 is captured)
Step 8:  Upon F7 by GPAWTZ no CD message was sent to (OAS).  The info loaded at Step 6, the TRDS_BL_IE_MSG was N.  So, did not create data in the PSMM hence no trigger at F7 .
 
In order to fix this issue from happening again, Is it possible to prompt USER 2 when doing step 6 that data has been amended by USER 1 and refresh the data. 
 
Regards
Elbin Eldhose

Hi Dedalus support team,
 
SGH user reported a case where user inappropriately performs reset encounter when another user is accessing visit at Dispensing Module.
 
Noticed the following unexpected behaviours highlighted in yellow. Seeking clarification on whether any of these behaviours would be incorrect and should be fixed.
 
Ÿ E-Rx SGH-25-12499521 for 0004-88-053-G, Ordered Qty calculated as 189 TAB, to round up to 190 TAB (sales multiple 10) at the dispensing pharmacy
Ÿ User 1 partial dispensed 90 TAB
Item History: Qty Out 190 then Qty In 100
Ÿ Not known if the following actions had occurred concurrently
? User 2 reset encounter
? User 1 F7 >> Send interface messages to SCM (medication dispensed), Fastrak (pick 90 tab), and OAS (bill 90 tab)
Ÿ User 2, open visit, and delete the dispensed transaction of 90 TAB
Item History: Qty In 100 then Qty In 90
Ÿ When User 2 F7, no interface message generated to send to SCM (to clear Medication Dispensed status), Fastrak (cancel picking) or OAS (cancel bill 90 tab)
Ÿ No stuck transaction seen at SendCancelDeleteMsg utility program (presumably, means not found at PSMM table). No messages is not created to send to SCM, fastrak and OAS for the transaction performed by User 2.
 
 
 
For your investigation and clarification for this scenario. Thank you.
 
Regds,

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Fairuz Syamimi Ehsanuddin, ​I have found the root cause and have corrected it. Based on the update today, 1. First we have request user to amend the result. 2. User have amended the result and using different Reason, however the new reason not appear on the PDF result but the old reason still available. 3. I have check again the data and found REMARK_CODE is missing from RL_RESULT_MODIFY_REASON for respective specimen number, while other specimen number is having REMARK_CODE. 4. I have update it with the REMARK_CODE following the same in Master>Reason. 5. Generate the PDF result again and Reason for modification no longer appear on PDF result. This issue is resolved. Kindly confirm and close it. Regards, Norhaiza Onn AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Fairuz Syamimi Ehsanuddin,

​I have found the root cause and have corrected it.

Based on the update today, 
1. First we have request user to amend the result. 
2. User have amended the result and using different Reason, however the new reason not appear on the PDF result but the old reason still available.
3. I have check again the data and found REMARK_CODE is missing from RL_RESULT_MODIFY_REASON for respective specimen number, while other specimen number is having REMARK_CODE.
4. I have update it with the REMARK_CODE following the same in Master>Reason.
5. Generate the PDF result again and Reason for modification no longer appear on PDF result.

This issue is resolved.
Kindly confirm and close it.


Regards,

Norhaiza Onn
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description:
From: Jade Lau <jlau32@adeahub.co> Sent: Tuesday, February 24, 2026 5:03 PM To: Salma Banu <salma.banu@adeahub.co>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg> Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co> Subject: RE: Delay in ADT message processing - 985
HI Idrus,
From the attached IBA tracer in SMXT for OAS ADT, we identified a system parameter being validated in OAS ADT program. This parameter is currently set to "T" in SKH, set to "F" in SGH, and not configured in KKH.
We recommend turning off this parameter by setting it to "F". After the change, we will monitor and assess whether system performance improves.
Parameter 'SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT' is set to 'T' in SMXP.
[cid:image011.png@01DCA5AC.829B0E30] Parameter 'SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT' is set to 'F' in SMXP.
[cid:image012.png@01DCA5AC.829B0E30]
We have checked the functionality of this parameter is to update the visit's bill category of the visit if the parameter is set to 'T'. The logic is as below: Step 1: PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings. Step 2: BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1). Step 3: When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to 'T', the system updates the VISIT.VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe. This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL (SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created. [cid:image001.png@01DCA5A6.69279C30]
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY (SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created. [cid:image002.png@01DCA5A6.69279C30] This means for bill category ORGTRSUB is applicable/eligible for Inpatient Admitted visit for Patient group - ORGTRSUB( Organ Transplant Subsidy). The list of patient is configured in 'Patient Group Setup' Program.
Screenshot taken from SMXT. [cid:image003.png@01DCA5A6.69279C30]
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP(SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
[cid:image007.png@01DCA5A6.CA553C10] SELECT * FROM BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST (SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
[cid:image008.png@01DCA5A6.CA553C10]
These patients configured in the Patient Group setup is not found in SMXP. Hence, turning off the parameter has no impact on this. [cid:image010.png@01DCA5A7.CABD5740]
Screenshot taken from SMXT. [cid:image004.png@01DCA5A6.69279C30]
[cid:image013.png@01DCA5AC.829B0E30]
Regards, Jade
helpdesk-ticket.subject: FW: Delay in ADT message processing - 985
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
From: Jade Lau <jlau32@adeahub.co>
Sent: Tuesday, February 24, 2026 5:03 PM
To: Salma Banu <salma.banu@adeahub.co>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg>
Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co>
Subject: RE: Delay in ADT message processing - 985
 
HI Idrus,
 
From the attached IBA tracer in SMXT for OAS ADT, we identified a system parameter being validated in OAS ADT program. This parameter is currently set to “T” in SKH, set to “F” in SGH, and not configured in KKH.
 
We recommend turning off this parameter by setting it to “F”. After the change, we will monitor and assess whether system performance improves.
 
 
Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘T’ in SMXP.
 
Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘F’ in SMXP.
 
 
We have checked the functionality of this parameter is to update the visit’s bill category of the visit if the parameter is set to ‘T’.
The logic is as below:
Step 1:
PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VISIT.VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.
 
 
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
This means for bill category ORGTRSUB is applicable/eligible for Inpatient Admitted visit for Patient group – ORGTRSUB( Organ Transplant Subsidy).
The list of patient is configured in ‘Patient Group Setup’ Program.
 
Screenshot taken from SMXT.

Hi Jade,
Good day.
Based on my analysis, the sequence to obtain the bill category value is as follows:
Step 1:
PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.

I have located the Functional Specification (FS) that documents the logic of AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT. Please refer to Sections 3.6, 3.7, and 3.8 of the FS for detailed information.
We need to verify whether SKH has any configurations set up for Patient Group Setup and Billing Category Status Setup.
  • If such configurations exist, then logically the system parameter can be set to ‘T’.
  • If no such configurations are available, enabling this parameter would serve no purpose.
 
Can you help to identify the tables related to Patient Group Setup and Billing Category Status Setup?

Jade

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hi Adeahub support team, SGH user reported backdated dispensed item on 22 Jan 2026 not being interface to SAP for billing. There is no interface messages created for the highlighted item (CEFAI01 – 0010-08-061-k). The item has been added in 22 Jan 2026 and processed with status “X” for interface but why there is no message created to be sent to SAP for billing. Encoutnered the following error after the search of the patient in dispensing program. It could be due to this ordered item from SCM send with BAG UOM captured in prescription tab. There is no message not created for the patient. Pls help to investigate. You may use this ticket (IN1455432) PAM request if require. Thanks. Regds,
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SGH Maxcare: No interface message created for a dispensed item to send to SAP for billing
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi Adeahub support team,
 
SGH user reported backdated dispensed item on 22 Jan 2026 not being interface to SAP for billing.
 
There is no interface messages created for the highlighted item (CEFAI01 – 0010-08-061-k).
 
 
The item has been added in 22 Jan 2026 and processed with status “X” for interface but why there is no message created to be sent to SAP for billing.
Encoutnered the following error after the search of the patient in dispensing program. It could be due to this ordered item from SCM send with BAG UOM captured in prescription tab.
 
There is no message not created for the patient.
 
Pls help to investigate.
 
You may use this ticket (IN1455432) PAM request if require.
 
Thanks.
 
Regds,

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan, ​จากการตรวจสอบ - ปัญหาเกิดจากเครื่อง PC Client มีการกำหนดค่า Database IP Address ในไฟล์ TNSNAME.ORA ไม่ถูกต้อง เมื่อทำการ Login โปรแกรมจะพยายามหา Domain (Database) นานมากจนรู้สึกว่าเครื่องค้าง ต้อง End task ออก - แก้ไขโดยตรวจสอบ ค่า parameter ต่างๆในไฟล์ TNSNAME.ORA ทั้ง Oracle 8i Client และ Oracle 6i Forms and Reports ให้ถูกต้อง ทดสอบ Database connection ด้วยชื่อและรหัสที่ต้องการ ผ่าน Oracle 8i Client และ Oracle 6i Forms and Reports ทดสอบ Login เข้าหน้า eHIS 2 Tier - สามารถใช้งานได้ตามปกติ Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan,

​จากการตรวจสอบ

- ปัญหาเกิดจากเครื่อง PC Client มีการกำหนดค่า Database IP Address ในไฟล์ TNSNAME.ORA ไม่ถูกต้อง 
เมื่อทำการ Login โปรแกรมจะพยายามหา Domain (Database) นานมากจนรู้สึกว่าเครื่องค้าง  ต้อง End task ออก 

- แก้ไขโดยตรวจสอบ ค่า parameter ต่างๆในไฟล์ TNSNAME.ORA ทั้ง Oracle 8i Client และ Oracle 6i Forms and Reports ให้ถูกต้อง
ทดสอบ Database connection ด้วยชื่อและรหัสที่ต้องการ ผ่าน Oracle 8i Client และ Oracle 6i Forms and Reports 
ทดสอบ Login เข้าหน้า eHIS 2 Tier - สามารถใช้งานได้ตามปกติ

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan, จากการตรวจสอบ - ปัญหานี้เกิดจากการกำหนดค่า User - Effective to เป็นวันที่ 31/12/2025 ซึ่งหมดอายุไปแล้ว ทำให้เมื่อ user login เข้าระบบ จึงเกิดการแจ้งเตือน "SM1043-Invalid date Effective Dates" ​- แก้ไขโดยการกำหนดค่า Effective to ใหม่ โดย เข้า Function - System Manager -> SM Admin Setup -> Application Security -> User ทำการ Query User ที่ต้องการ แลัวกำหนดค่า Effective to ใหม่ (ในการกำหนดครั้งนี้ ใช้เป็นค่าว่าง = ไม่มีวันหนดอายุ) Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan,

จากการตรวจสอบ
- ปัญหานี้เกิดจากการกำหนดค่า User - Effective to เป็นวันที่ 31/12/2025 ซึ่งหมดอายุไปแล้ว ทำให้เมื่อ user login เข้าระบบ จึงเกิดการแจ้งเตือน "SM1043-Invalid date Effective Dates"
​- แก้ไขโดยการกำหนดค่า  Effective to ใหม่ 
โดย เข้า Function - System Manager -> SM Admin Setup -> Application Security -> User
ทำการ Query User ที่ต้องการ แลัวกำหนดค่า Effective to ใหม่  (ในการกำหนดครั้งนี้ ใช้เป็นค่าว่าง = ไม่มีวันหนดอายุ)

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: ONCO-SCF-0020 : NPHIES latest patches to be delivered : Not able to resend the Pre-auth if there is any adjudication error. ALL the latest patches which are delivered to Nahdi customer has to be delivered to ONCO customer as well. currently we identified the issue that explained below In the record approval screen, we sent one lab service for the pre-auth to NPHIES. NPHIES sent the adjudication error that Doctor license number not exists. after correcting the data, User wanted to resend the same pre-auth again to NPHIES by changing from Error status to 'Send to Insurance' but system not resending the request to NPHIEs in this case. but this was working fine in Nahdi customer environment. it is the existing feature of NPHIES integration. so, please regularize the latest functionalities and patches whatever delivered to Nahdi.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hi AdeaHub Support team, Issue: Cannot find the user name or id when doing partial search in Maxcare User Account Setup program. This issue has cause delay in the termination or activation of the user account in Maxcare. User accounts with same name cannot be display in the system when search by the name. eg NCCS Maxcare => A user ( “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”) with two accounts (PHMNKH, NPANKH) when search for “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”, only NPANKH record appeared in the list. Request: To have a wildcard search for the user name and account. Sort and display the matched record base on the search data field. When create new account, alert the administrator that there is another account with the same name created in the system. Regds,
helpdesk-ticket.subject: All Sites: Maxcare User id and name search issue in User Account setup
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi AdeaHub Support team,
 
Issue: Cannot find the user name or id when doing partial search in Maxcare User Account Setup program.
 
This issue has cause delay in the termination or activation of the user account in Maxcare. User accounts with same name cannot be display in the system when search by the name. eg NCCS Maxcare => A user ( “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”) with two accounts (PHMNKH, NPANKH)  when search for “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”, only NPANKH record appeared in the list.
 
Request: To have a wildcard search for the user name and account. Sort and display the matched record base on the search data field. When create new account, alert the administrator that there is another account with the same name created in the system.
 
Regds,

helpdesk-ticket.subject: Request to Amendment MR Setup - Parameters for Diagnosis,
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Refer to the email received from Sri,  regarding diagnosis code “UD” to  disable from EM-HIS. in the Setup, as PIK has already disabled code 03 – Underlying Cause of Death in the SMRP portal.

Please be informed that the “UD” code has now been disabled. code “UC” will be used as the Principal Diagnosis for death cases.

In addition, we would like to request your assistance to amend the MR parameters so that the Primary Diagnosis Classification is set to Underlying COD (code UC).
----------------------------------------------------
From: Srinivasah A/L Muniandy <smuniandy@adeahub.co>
Sent: 26 February 2026 5:54 PM
To: Noorasmira Abd Hamid - ProHAWK <noorasmira.hamid@uemnet.com>
Cc: Abdul Bari Yusoff - ProHAWK <bari.yusoff@uemnet.com>; fadzilah <fadzilah@datacryptic.my>
Subject: RE: #1974 : Semakan Penetapan Diagnosis Cause of Death dan Underlying Cause of Death dalam HIS HTA
 
Caution: [EXTERNAL EMAIL] CAUTION: This email originated from outside of the organization. DO NOT click links or open attachments unless you recognize the sender and know the content(s) are safe. When in doubt, always check on FULL email address of sender.
 
Dear @Noorasmira Abd Hamid - ProHAWK,
 
I have rectified this issue. Please disable the diagnosis code “UD” from EM-HIS. As per SMRP mapping, PIK has disabled the code 03 – Underlying Cause of Death in SMRP portal.
 
Please inform MRD to confirm again with a PIK team.
 
 
 
 Thank you
 
 Srinivasah Muniandy
Application & Technical Deployment Management Senior Specialist
 
m. +60 192546524
e.   smuniandy@adeahub.co

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Hi AdeaHub Support team,
Issue: Cannot find the user name or id when doing partial search in Maxcare User Account Setup program.
This issue has cause delay in the termination or activation of the user account in Maxcare. User accounts with same name cannot be display in the system when search by the name. eg NCCS Maxcare => A user ( “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”) with two accounts (PHMNKH, NPANKH) when search for “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”, only NPANKH record appeared in the list.
Request: To have a wildcard search for the user name and account. Sort and display the matched record base on the search data field. When create new account, alert the administrator that there is another account with the same name created in the system.
Regds,
helpdesk-ticket.subject: All Sites: Maxcare User id and name search issue in User Account setup
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi AdeaHub Support team,
 
Issue: Cannot find the user name or id when doing partial search in Maxcare User Account Setup program.
 
This issue has cause delay in the termination or activation of the user account in Maxcare. User accounts with same name cannot be display in the system when search by the name. eg NCCS Maxcare => A user ( “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”) with two accounts (PHMNKH, NPANKH)  when search for “Vincent Ngo Kang Hao”, only NPANKH record appeared in the list.
 
Request: To have a wildcard search for the user name and account. Sort and display the matched record base on the search data field. When create new account, alert the administrator that there is another account with the same name created in the system.
 
Regds,

helpdesk-ticket.description:
rejected message is not updating clinical repository

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Hi Saravanan,
There are 59 cases found in SGH Prod that encounter no in the PSRE table is captured as '*'and null in bltx table in past 365 days. Upon further investigating some records, I found some of the missing encounter records also have null value in the bltx_visit_no.
Need to look into finalization logic in dispensing. I suspect the dispensing screen is not clear while backend encounter has been closed.
We shall discuss this next week.
Attach 3 cases I checked.
Regards, Jade
From: Jade Lau Sent: Thursday, 26 February 2026 4:29 pm To: 'Er Wei May (Synapxe)' <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg>; Salma Banu <salma.banu@adeahub.co>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co> Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg> Subject: RE: #1943 - (SGH Maxcare Production) Transaction / Balance not seen at Maxcare Dispensing module (IN1467989)
HI Wei May,
Based on the data provided, the dispensed records reported correspond to observation number #0010003EK25A.
There is currently no remaining balance under this observation number, as three partial dispenses were completed. Each partial dispense consisted of 120 capsules, totalling 360 capsules dispensed. This matches the ordered quantity of 360 capsules, and the order has therefore been fully dispensed. [cid:image002.png@01DCA67A.964DE320] [cid:image008.png@01DCA67A.964DE320]
Users are unable to view the third partial dispense due to the following issues:
* The PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO field is missing in the PATIENT_SERVICE_EVENT table, which prevents the dispense record from being displayed in the dispensing module. * Additionally, the BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO field is missing in the billing table for Step 2. Each partial dispense consists of 120 capsules. The 1st Dispense - PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO used was 00100060VEUT and BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO recorded was 00100060VF2I. The 2nd Dispense - PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO used was 00100060VFEI and BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO recoded was 00100060VK8K. The 3rd Dispense - PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO used was * and BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO recorded null. [cid:image001.png@01DCA67A.964DE320]
[cid:image005.png@01DCA67B.99767DE0] These are the details of the three partial dispenses done by the user: The 1st partial dispense was to step 0 to visit #6824242315G0050 (0010000S8S3H) and created on 13 Feb 2026 15:46:17 by GPALYJ. The 2nd parital dispsed was step 1 to visit #6824242315G0051 (0010000S8S5T) and created on 13 Feb 2026 15:50:43 by GPALYJ. The 3rd partial dispense was step 2 to visit #6824242315G0051 (0010000S8S5T) and created on 13 Feb 2026 15:51:40 by GPALYJ.
[cid:image004.png@01DCA67B.39D52350]
The item history related to observation number #0010003EK25A. [cid:image016.png@01DCA727.E07995E0] Below are outqueue billing messages related to observation number #0010003EK25A. [cid:image014.png@01DCA684.84428C80]
To rectify the data, we need to run these 2 patching scripts:
--SELECT * FROM PATIENT_SERVICE_EVENT UPDATE PATIENT_SERVICE_EVENT SET PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO = '00100060VFHG' WHERE PSRE_OBSERVATION_NO = '0010003EK25A' AND PSRE_STEP = 2 AND PSRE_EVENT = 'DSP' AND PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO = '*';
--SELECT * FROM BILLING_tRANSACTION UPDATE BILLING_TRANSACTION SET BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO = '00100060VFHG' WHERE BLTX_REFERENCE_NUMBER = '0010003E6RDG' AND BLTX_OBSERVATION_NO = '0010003EK25A' AND BLTX_STEP = 2 AND BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO IS NULL;
The cause of the issue is stil under investigation.
Based on the encounter: I need the user to provide feedback after the 2nd partial supply and after the script was finalized. The user then modified the 2nd partial dispense from 240 capsules to 120 capsules. What other functions did he/she access or actions take within the same visit before finalizing the scrip?
The 1st Dispense - PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO used was 00100060VEUT and BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO recorded was 00100060VF2I. The 2nd Dispense - PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO used was 00100060VFEI and BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO recoded was 00100060VK8K. The 3rd Dispense - PSRE_ENCOUNTER_NO used was * and BLTX_ENCOUNTER_NO recorded null.
OTKW_MESSAGE_ID OTKW_CREATED_AT Encounter No used ENCO_START_DATETIME ENCO_END_DATETIME Remarks. IHST_ADD_DATE 0008PQHV0 13.02.2026 15:46:48 00100060VEUT 13.02.2026 15:45:41 13.02.2026 15:46:49 Step 0 - 1st partial dispense. Normal F7 the visit/script 13.02.2026 15:46:17 0008PQIGJ 13.02.2026 15:50:36 00100060VF2I 13.02.2026 15:47:40 13.02.2026 15:50:37 Modify step 0 dispense. Normal F7 the visit/script. This is CD msg 13.02.2026 15:47:47 0008PQIGK 13.02.2026 15:50:36 00100060VF2I 13.02.2026 15:47:40 13.02.2026 15:50:37 Same as above. This is CG msg.
0008PQII5 13.02.2026 15:50:54 00100060VFEI 13.02.2026 15:50:38 13.02.2026 15:50:56 Step 1- 2nd partial dispense. Normal F7 the visit/script 13.02.2026 15:50:43 0008PQIK9 13.02.2026 15:51:31 00100060VFHG 13.02.2026 15:51:12 13.02.2026 15:51:42 Modify Step 1 partial dispense. The message was triggered before the encounter was closed, so it is suspected that some actions were performed during the visit (e.g., checking another prescription within the same visit). Please confirm with the users which function was used after this. This is a CD message. 13.02.2026 15:51:21 0008PQIKD 13.02.2026 15:51:32 00100060VFHG 13.02.2026 15:51:12 13.02.2026 15:51:42 Same as above. This is CG msg.
No msg triggered No msg triggered 00100060VFHG 13.02.2026 15:51:12 13.02.2026 15:51:42 Step 2- 3rd partial dispense. 13.02.2026 15:51:40
[cid:image015.png@01DCA685.42DE5340]
Regard, Jade

User reports issue at Maxcare Production where Transaction / Balance is not seen at Maxcare Dispensing module.
Script number SGH-26-12861433, order for 0004-10-083-H Nilotinib 150mg Cap [TASIGNA], total qty 360 CAP
* User dispenses 120 CAP into visit 6824242315G0050 by performing the following steps:

helpdesk-ticket.description:
We are currently facing an issue while processing sales to patients through the Kit Template.
It has been observed that on a random basis, some items are either getting missed or extra items are being charged during billing. We have received multiple calls from users regarding this concern.
In the attached sample, when the kit template was charged for the first time, a different amount was reflected. Upon checking the details, we found that two items were missing. However, during the second attempt, the correct amount was generated(without any changes).
Since this issue is occurring intermittently and affecting billing accuracy, we request you to please investigate and rectify the problem at the earliest.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-SCF-3068: Issue in Sale to Patient through Kit Template
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
We are currently facing an issue while processing sales to patients through the Kit Template.

It has been observed that on a random basis, some items are either getting missed or extra items are being charged during billing. We have received multiple calls from users regarding this concern.

In the attached sample, when the kit template was charged for the first time, a different amount was reflected. Upon checking the details, we found that two items were missing. However, during the second attempt, the correct amount was generated(without any changes).

Since this issue is occurring intermittently and affecting billing accuracy, we request you to please investigate and rectify the problem at the earliest.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
We are currently facing an issue while processing sales to patients through the Kit Template.
It has been observed that on a random basis, some items are either getting missed or extra items are being charged during billing. We have received multiple calls from users regarding this concern.
In the attached sample, when the kit template was charged for the first time, a different amount was reflected. Upon checking the details, we found that two items were missing. However, during the second attempt, the correct amount was generated(without any changes).
Since this issue is occurring intermittently and affecting billing accuracy, we request you to please investigate and rectify the problem at the earliest.

helpdesk-ticket.description: While doing NPHIES Eligibility Check , sometimes users making mistakes while admitting patient without eligibility check , Or sometimes receptionist will enter all policy details and inquire eligibility but NPHIES may response as "Invalid" then user are just using Offline flag to proceed with the visit registration which is not right ! Due to this gap we have many transactions everyday more than 50 cases entered without valid eligibility , which had caused huge re-work at month end by claim team to enter the correct Membership details. This need to handle this from system wise, as we have many facilities and huge number of users, our finance team cannot go and track all those cases. So this offline Eligibility check option should be restricted by payer group ; and once this offline flag is restricted, then only authorized users can override this restriction and use when its really needed.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NMC-JD-CRF-0264 | Eligibility Check offline flag should be controled and restricted
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
While doing NPHIES Eligibility Check , sometimes users making mistakes while admitting patient without eligibility check ,

Or sometimes receptionist will enter all policy details and inquire eligibility but NPHIES may response as "Invalid" then user are just using Offline flag to proceed with the visit registration which is not right !

Due to this gap we have many transactions everyday more than 50 cases entered without valid eligibility , which had caused huge re-work at month end by claim team to enter the correct Membership details. This need to handle this from system wise, as we have many facilities and huge number of users, our finance team cannot go and track all those cases.

So this offline Eligibility check option should be restricted by payer group ; and once this offline flag is restricted, then only authorized users can override this restriction and use when its really needed.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Azura Binti Md Darus, Current logic for Waiting Time as below: Waiting Time formula Based on new KPI guidelines, seems like 1. Remove Exclusion 1 & 2 2. Change the Standard from > 90% to >75% 3. All calculation no longer consider the event sequence if Appt Time is bigger or lower than register time and only takes Register Time to Start Consultation Time only Affected dashboard = Waiting Time Performance > Waiting Time 2024. Please confirm this. Else we could arrange meeting with respective user to confirm on the new calculation before I change it. Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Azura Binti Md Darus,

Current logic for Waiting Time as below:


Waiting Time formula

Based on new KPI guidelines, seems like 
1. Remove Exclusion 1 & 2
2. Change the Standard from > 90% to >75%
3. All calculation no longer consider the event sequence if Appt Time is bigger or lower than register time and only takes Register Time to Start Consultation Time only

Affected dashboard = Waiting Time Performance > Waiting Time 2024.

Please confirm this. Else we could arrange meeting with respective user to confirm on the new calculation before I change it.


Regards,
AdeaHub

Today, the ward contacted the user and informed them that the result could not be viewed because the order status shows as discontinued. Although the system indicates that the order was discontinued by the user, the reporting user confirmed that they did not discontinue the order. The user would like to understand why this issue keeps occurring. A similar incident also happened on 05/02/2026 and has recurred again today, despite the order not being discontinued by the reporting user. SD00671515

Order the GSH request as below : Enter and release the result Because this is GSH request, lab user will wait for the clinician to call and convert it to GXM, if no call this remain as GSH and the status in CA as below : However, if user do cleaning data by using the Specimen/Order completion function as below : The status in CA changes as below : This is how the status becomes Discontinued. Regards, Norshafina AdeaHub

However, if user do cleaning data by using the Specimen/Order completion function as below :

This is how the status becomes Discontinued. 

Regards,

helpdesk-ticket.description: Whenever connection for interface is lost, user is not aware of it when they see interface engine. Since errors are not visible from interface engine and can only be seen from log file, users are unable to know if the interface is connected or lost. Users request the connection status to be visible from Interface engine, so they could restart the interface directly. E.g. 1. Interface Status: CONNECTED 2. Interface Status: DISCONNECTED
helpdesk-ticket.subject: ML-MMOH-SCF-3464 : Remisol issue when connection lost
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Whenever connection for interface is lost, user is not aware of it when they see interface engine.
Since errors are not visible from interface engine and can only be seen from log file, users are unable to know if the interface is connected or lost. 
Users request the connection status to be visible from Interface engine, so they could restart the interface directly.
E.g. 
1. Interface Status: CONNECTED
2. Interface Status: DISCONNECTED

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Fairuz Syamimi Ehsanuddin, 2 issues reported. As per solution given below, this issues are resolved. Critical range indicator not reflect on the result for K test when result is on the critical range. Example: Critical range = 2.8 to 6.0. Patient's result = 6.0 Solution : Advise to change the critical range to 2.81 and 5.99. If setup available for Age/Sex Range, both ranges required changed. Outcome : Patient with result < 2.8 and > 6.0 will be highlighted as critical. Reference range not reflex on the test. Findings : Based on earlier issue encountered for HCLAB test, (Ticket 2040), this issue happenned when data setup for Report Range(at validation tab) is missing if test is only having Age/Sex Range. Solution : Advise to set Report Range using Adult Range. Outcome : Reference range will be available accordingly to patient's Age/Sex Range. Regards Norhaiza Onn AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Fairuz Syamimi Ehsanuddin,

2 issues reported. As per solution given below, this issues are resolved.

  1. Critical range indicator not reflect on the result for K test when result is on the critical range. Example: Critical range = 2.8 to 6.0. Patient's result = 6.0
    • Solution : Advise to change the critical range to 2.81 and 5.99. If setup available for Age/Sex Range, both ranges required changed.
    • Outcome : Patient with result < 2.8 and > 6.0 will be highlighted as critical.
  2. Reference range not reflex on the test.
    • Findings : Based on earlier issue encountered for HCLAB test, (Ticket 2040), this issue happenned when data setup for Report Range(at validation tab) is missing if test is only having Age/Sex Range.
    • Solution : Advise to set Report Range using Adult Range. 
    • Outcome : Reference range will be available accordingly to patient's Age/Sex Range.

Regards

Norhaiza Onn
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: MRD has conducted a review and found that the RH101 data integrated into SMRP is incomplete. Based on the verification in HIS, the total number of records is 1,073 (Admissions). However, the data successfully integrated into SMRP shows only 971 (Admissions) and 605 (Discharges). This issue affects both the RH101 Admission Data and Discharge Data for September 2025. Attached (in email) are the JSON files for September 2025 along with screenshots of the data integrated into SMRP for your reference. We would appreciate it if you could review the JSON files to determine whether there are any errors related to this issue. helpdesk-ticket.description: It is common for medication within a chemotherapy regimen to exist multiple times in the same cycle (order set) with different doses, frequencies, or administration details. However, when we duplicate a medication within the order set, the newly created record does not receive a new sequence number; instead, it retains the same sequence as the original entry. Assigning a unique sequence number to each medication, along with all associated details—including dose, frequency, administration, and infusion‑related details—is essential to ensure accuracy and maintain patient safety throughout chemotherapy workflows.

helpdesk-note.body: แจ้งวิธีตรวจสอบข้อมูลตามที่แจ้งมาให้ทางศิริราชรับทราบแล้วค่ะ รอแจ้งกลับ หากตรวจสอบข้อมูลย้อนหลังไม่ได้และต้องไปหาpaperจากใบนำส่งจากหน้างานที่เคาน์เตอร์นั้นๆ มองว่าไม่น่าจะจะสะดวกกับการตรวจสอบข้อมูลในวิธีนี้นะคะ แต่อย่างไรได้แจ้งทางศิริราชไปแล้ว หากได้ข้อมูลมาไว้เอาข้อมูลมาประกอบการหาสาเหตุได้ค่ะ อยากให้ทางบริษัท ลองตรวจสอบการทำงานของรายงานนี้มีหลักการดึงข้อมูลมาอย่างไรในช่องนี้ จะได้ตรวจสอบว่าข้อมูลที่ได้้รับแจ้งในวันที่เกิดปัญหานั้นตรงตามเงื่อนไขที่รายงานต้องแสดงหรือไม่ น่าจะเป็นวิธีที่บริษัทต้องตรวจสอบด้วยนะคะ เพราะอย่างไรแล้วก็เป็นรายงานในระบบ eHIS ที่ทางบริษัทพัฒนาขึ้นมา ไม่ใช่รายงานจากระบบอื่น
helpdesk-note.body-html:
แจ้งวิธีตรวจสอบข้อมูลตามที่แจ้งมาให้ทางศิริราชรับทราบแล้วค่ะ รอแจ้งกลับ

หากตรวจสอบข้อมูลย้อนหลังไม่ได้และต้องไปหาpaperจากใบนำส่งจากหน้างานที่เคาน์เตอร์นั้นๆ มองว่าไม่น่าจะจะสะดวกกับการตรวจสอบข้อมูลในวิธีนี้นะคะ แต่อย่างไรได้แจ้งทางศิริราชไปแล้ว หากได้ข้อมูลมาไว้เอาข้อมูลมาประกอบการหาสาเหตุได้ค่ะ

อยากให้ทางบริษัท ลองตรวจสอบการทำงานของรายงานนี้มีหลักการดึงข้อมูลมาอย่างไรในช่องนี้ จะได้ตรวจสอบว่าข้อมูลที่ได้้รับแจ้งในวันที่เกิดปัญหานั้นตรงตามเงื่อนไขที่รายงานต้องแสดงหรือไม่ น่าจะเป็นวิธีที่บริษัทต้องตรวจสอบด้วยนะคะ เพราะอย่างไรแล้วก็เป็นรายงานในระบบ eHIS ที่ทางบริษัทพัฒนาขึ้นมา ไม่ใช่รายงานจากระบบอื่น

helpdesk-note.body: จากที่ทางบริษัทให้ทำการตรวจสอบใบนำส่งเงินย้อนหลัง ทางฝั่งการเงินศิริราชแจ้งว่าไม่สามารถตรวจสอบได้เนื่องจากเอกสารส่งคลังไปแล้วค่ะ

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan, ​ขอ Query เพิ่มตามด้านล่างครับ -- Query 1 SELECT * FROM BL_CANCELLED_BILLS WHERE CASH_COUNTER_CODE = 'I01R' AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) >= TO_DATE('04/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) < TO_DATE('05/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY'); -- Query 2 SELECT * FROM BL_CANCELLED_BOUNCED_TRX WHERE CASH_COUNTER_CODE = 'I01R' AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) >= TO_DATE('04/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) < TO_DATE('05/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY'); Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan,

​ขอ Query เพิ่มตามด้านล่างครับ 

-- Query 1
SELECT *
FROM BL_CANCELLED_BILLS
WHERE CASH_COUNTER_CODE = 'I01R'
  AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) >= TO_DATE('04/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) <  TO_DATE('05/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY');

-- Query 2
SELECT *
FROM BL_CANCELLED_BOUNCED_TRX
WHERE CASH_COUNTER_CODE = 'I01R'
  AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) >= TO_DATE('04/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  AND TRUNC(ADDED_DATE) <  TO_DATE('05/03/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY');

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: AAKH-SCF-0664-Immiunization - ADT records going wrong to Malaffi Malaffi reported that observation related to immunization data received from your facility wrong parameters. We have observed multiple immunization records successfully received. However, for some of these cases, there is no corresponding ADT (patient registration/update) message received. As a result, the patient demographic or encounter information linked to those immunizations is not available. As you are aware, ADT messages are essential for establishing and maintaining accurate patient context in the system, the absence of these messages may impact data integrity and downstream reporting. Attached the Immunization messages spreadsheet for review.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Amr Elsokary, This issue is caused by entering multiple expiry dates for the same batch number. According to the current system logic, when an item exists under a single batch with more than one expiry date, the system checks the nearest expiry date to determine whether an available quantity exists. If a quantity is available, it is displayed; otherwise, an insufficient quantity message is shown. In reported case, all quantity with the nearest expiry is committed. Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Amr Elsokary,
This issue is caused by entering multiple expiry dates for the same batch number. According to the current system logic, when an item exists under a single batch with more than one expiry date, the system checks the nearest expiry date to determine whether an available quantity exists. If a quantity is available, it is displayed; otherwise, an insufficient quantity message is shown.
In reported case, all quantity with the nearest expiry is committed.
Regards,
AdeaHub

One item shows the error, while the other does not for example this item gives the error 300-00809 This one works normally 300-00805 . Appreciate your update

helpdesk-ticket.description:
NHCS reported that there are many cases occurred, where Maxcare responded the same sequence number to HealthHub. Upon checking, found that Maxcare is not returning the same sequence number from SCM. The sequence number that Maxcare returned is different from the sequence number from SCM.
Below is the example. The sequence number for Warfarin from SCM is 2, but the sequence number that Maxcare responded to HealthHub is 1 and 3. The sequence number for Simvastatin from SCM is 5, but the sequence number that Maxcare responded to HealthHub is 2.
Can help to check why Maxcare is responding to HealthHub with another sequence number that is different from the sequence number received from SCM? How can we reproduce the same scenario in Maxcare, for Maxcare to respond to HealthHub with the same sequence number for different order?

helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-SCF-3069: BILL LEVEL GL NOT SHOWING IN INTERFACE, BL_GL_DISTRIBUTION table
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Currently we have observed that when we select a Discount GL Code while giving a Bill Level Discount in HIS, the same GL Code is getting stored in the BL_BILL_HDR table. However, the same GL Code is not appearing in the BL_GL_DISTRIBUTION table or in the SAP Interface table.

Now the Finance Team would like to understand which GL Code is being used for Bill Level Discount and which GL Code is used for Line Level Discount from the system side.

Requesting you to please look into this matter and provide clarification.

SELECT OVR_DISC_ACC_INT_CODE,A.* FROM BL_BILL_HDR A
WHERE OPERATING_FACILITY_ID='GH'
AND PATIENT_ID='MM03227883' AND EPISODE_ID =    '23936223'
AND DOC_TYPE_CODE ='GHIPCR' AND DOC_NUM ='26049265';

SELECT * FROM IBAEHIS.BL_GL_DISTRIBUTION
WHERE OPERATING_FACILITY_ID ='GH'
AND PATIENT_ID='MM03227883' AND EPISODE_ID =    '23936223'
 AND MAIN_ACC1_CODE ='500000' AND MAIN_ACC2_CODE ='0730';
